status: source-reviewed supplemental documentation; does not replace frozen training manifests

common.scope: Canonical F06 schedule graph; same-season completed games through the source-state week, before the future target. One observation per game ID. Teams are the source season team universe; out-of-universe opponents contribute team counts and wins/losses but not matrix off-diagonals or PageRank edges.
common.inputs: Prior game IDs, team/opponent IDs, source week, realized prior-game team margin; scheduled next opponent only for the edge feature.
common.garbage_time_handling: No play filtering; uses completed game margin, capped at 35 only in the PageRank edge weight.
common.colley_definition: Named ranges: games_i counts incident completed games; meetings_ij counts games between known teams. C_ii=2+games_i; C_ij=-meetings_ij for i<>j. b_i=1+(wins_i-losses_i)/2. r=MMULT(MINVERSE(C),b). Ties add counts but no win/loss term.
common.pagerank_definition: A_loser,winner += 1+MIN(ABS(margin),35)/14. If ABS(margin)<=7, A_winner,loser += 0.25. Ties add no edges. Row-normalize A; replace zero rows with 1/N. Initialize p0_i=1/N; exactly 50 updates pk=(1-0.85)/N+0.85*MMULT(TRANSPOSE(P),p_previous). z_i=(p50_i-AVERAGE(p50))/IF(STDEV.P(p50)>0,STDEV.P(p50),1).
common.minimum_sample_rule: Empty graph gives Colley 0.5 and PageRank z=0; opponent subsets without known entries return 0.5. Counts start at zero. No additional support threshold.

graph_colley_rating.positive_negative_meaning: Higher means stronger schedule-adjusted win/loss evidence; 0.5 is the empty-history prior.
graph_colley_rating.film_intuition: Winning against connected opponents raises evidence of team strength.

graph_pagerank_z.positive_negative_meaning: Positive/negative means above/below the season graph mean PageRank after 50 updates.
graph_pagerank_z.film_intuition: Credit travels through wins; close losses return a smaller edge of credit.

graph_schedule_strength.positive_negative_meaning: Higher means stronger known opponents faced; repeat opponents are counted per meeting.
graph_schedule_strength.film_intuition: Distinguishes a demanding schedule from weak opposition.

graph_win_quality.positive_negative_meaning: Higher means stronger known opponents beaten; empty subset is 0.5, not evidence of average-quality wins.
graph_win_quality.film_intuition: Measures the quality of opponents behind the wins.

graph_loss_quality.positive_negative_meaning: Higher means losses came against stronger known opponents; empty subset is 0.5. It is not a count of losses.
graph_loss_quality.film_intuition: Adds context to losses against strong opposition.

graph_games_played.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative count; higher means more graph evidence, not necessarily better performance.
graph_games_played.film_intuition: Separates an established record from a small sample.

graph_unique_opponents.positive_negative_meaning: Nonnegative count including out-of-universe opponents; higher means broader schedule exposure.
graph_unique_opponents.film_intuition: Distinguishes repeated matchups from diverse opposition.

graph_colley_edge_next.positive_negative_meaning: Positive means the team exceeds its scheduled next opponent in prior-state Colley rating; negative means the reverse.
graph_colley_edge_next.film_intuition: A schedule-strength comparison specific to the upcoming matchup.
